verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS/API platform (not itself an agent), so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis, and Carta documents exactly this: a Claude MCP setup guide with pre-built plugins for cap table, investors, and fund data accessible via natural language queries. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond Carta's own docs, and details on setup robustness or broader client support beyond Claude.
